result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a rename end to end.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip step at the end of the data export. I replaced the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` names with a loop over the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects, in that order. The loop gets each file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same method that writes the loose text files, so the zip reads back exactly the names the files were written under.

With the default configuration the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written when `git-history.txt` exists.
